keySentence: He bravely told the truth in court to save someone.

facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: Tom told the court what he saw. Muff Potter was set free. Tom was called a hero. He bravely told the truth in court to save someone.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: Tom stood before the judge and told everything he had seen. Injun Joe jumped through a window and escaped into the night. Muff Potter was freed and cried tears of joy and thanks. He bravely told the truth in court to save someone innocent. The whole town praised Tom for his incredible courage. Tom learned that doing the right thing is always worth the fear.
facts.Word cards: to save = 구하기 위해 / set free = 자유를 줬다 / bravely = 용감하게 / someone = 누군가
